title: zanthoxylum schinifolium var. subinermis
intro: Zanthoxylum schinifolium var. subinermis, commonly known as Korean prickly ash, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in Korean and Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Korean prickly ash include flavonoids, terpenoids, and lignans, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as pain relief, fever reduction, and improved digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are also attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
